mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coach_change_request (id, student_id, current_coach_id, new_coach_id, reason, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{currentCoachId}, #{newCoachId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coach_change_request WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM coach_change_request WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE coach_change_request SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
